Width-to-length, so the value stays within [0,1]. About 0.14 means the design area is roughly seven times longer than it is wide -- the linear rail-corridor form that makes the Y-shaped switchback reading possible on this specific site and not on a square or radial one.

road_length_m.formula: sum(length(road_centerlines)); polygon_area computed in EPSG:4548 (CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger CM 117E).
assumptions: Conceptual network: one trunk greenway, five east-west seams and one neighbourhood loop. Not a road red-line or alignment.

site_anchor_argument.formula: qualitative narrative (not a measured quantity): this proposal's core claims rest on (1) Jing-Zhang railway first autonomous survey and datum, (2) the 1:7 linear rail-corridor form, and (3) the three taskbook-named key areas. See assumptions.json#A-SITE-ANCHOR-001 for the full set of underlying facts and their scope.
assumptions: This entry is a narrative argument, not a measured statistic; the previously listed numeric site_anchor_dependency_ratio is removed in response to the AI review (its value of 1.0 was a single-author coding and could not be cross-checked against an external corpus).

floor_area_ratio.reason: Regulatory detailed plan, plot FAR and building height controls have not been released by the organiser; supplying a number would imply a statutory conclusion.

building_height_m.reason: No official height control or surveyed building data is available in the site package.

total_floor_area_sqm.reason: Depends on FAR and height controls that the organiser has not supplied.
